title_zh: 波密县易贡乡：甜蜜西瓜铺就乡村振兴共富路
title_en: Sweet Watermelon Harvest Paves Way for Rural Revitalization in Bomi County's Yigong Township
summary_zh: 2026年8月13日，波密县易贡乡发展西瓜种植，带动村民增收，为乡村振兴铺就甜蜜共富路。
summary_en: On August 13, 2026, Yigong Township in Bomi County developed watermelon farming to increase villagers' incomes, paving a sweet road to rural revitalization and common prosperity.
